确定删除选中的 {{n}} 个用户吗？此操作不可撤销。: Delete the {{n}} selected users? This cannot be undone.

社交登录不可用（oauth2 插件未启用或接口异常）。: Social sign-in is unavailable — the oauth2 plugin is disabled or the endpoint is failing.
管理后台账号、部门归属与角色分配。: Manage admin accounts, departments and role assignment.
类型编码是业务代码引用字典的键，创建后尽量不要改。: The type code is how business code references the dictionary — avoid changing it after creation.
系统上传文件的统一入口，支持预览、下载与批量清理。: One place for every uploaded file — preview, download and bulk cleanup.
系统发信用的 SMTP 服务器。密码以密文展示。: The SMTP server the system sends from. The password is masked.
系统级动态参数。登录与口令策略是活的 —— 改完立刻对所有人生效。: System-wide dynamic parameters. Sign-in and password policies are live — changes apply to everyone immediately.
系统里还没有任何规则，用「新建规则」建第一条: No rules yet — use New rule to create the first one
组织、角色和数据范围各自成件，靠结构咬合：改一处授权，落到每一个菜单、按钮和数据: Orgs, roles and data scopes are separate pieces joined by structure: change one grant and it lands on every menu, button and row.
组织架构树。数据权限的隔离就建在这棵树上。: The org tree. Data-scope isolation is built on it.
绑定会新开一页跳到对方的授权页。需要服务端先配好 <c>OAUTH2_*_CLI: Linking opens the provider’s authorization page in a new tab. The server needs <c>OAUTH2_*_CLIENT_ID / SECRET</c> and the callback URL configured first — without them the provider simply refuses, and this page cannot help.
绑定后可用该账号直接登录: Once linked you can sign in with it directly
给代码和外部系统用的稳定标识，如 AUDITOR。大写字母开头。: A stable identifier for code and external systems, e.g. AUDITOR. Must start with an uppercase letter.
给代码和外部系统用的稳定标识，如 FIN、TECH_DEV。大写字母开头。: A stable identifier for code and external systems, e.g. FIN, TECH_DEV. Must start with an uppercase letter.
维护自己的资料与登录密码: Manage your own profile and password
缓存实例的实时状态。会话、验证码、权限缓存都落在这里。: Live state of the cache instance. Sessions, captchas and permission caches all live here.
编码为 2–32 位大写字母、数字或下划线，且以字母开头: Code must be 2–32 characters: uppercase letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter
编码创建后不可修改 —— 配置、数据权限规则和外部系统都按它引用这个部门。: The code cannot be changed after creation — configuration, data permission rules and external systems all reference this department by it.
编码创建后不可修改 —— 配置和外部系统都按它引用这个角色。: The code cannot be changed after creation — configuration and external systems reference this role by it.
编码只能用小写字母、数字和下划线，且以字母开头: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter

范围已停用，这些规则不生效: This scope is disabled, so these rules do not apply
获取数据范围所有规则: Get all rules in a data scope
获取数据规则值可用模板变量: Get template variables for rule values

获取角色所有数据范围: Get all data scopes of a role
装完需要按插件的 README 配置并<b>重启后端服务</b>才会生效。后端限: After installing, configure it per the plugin’s README and restart the backend for it to take effect. The backend allows this only in a development environment.
要求密码里至少有一个非字母数字字符: Require at least one non-alphanumeric character
要让它生效，先在角色编辑里把开关打开。: To make them apply, turn the switch on in the role editor first.
规则最终会被翻译成一个 WHERE 条件，由后端 <c>filter_data_: A rule is ultimately translated into a WHERE clause that the backend’s <c>filter_data_permission</c> splices into the query.
视图只存在这台电脑上，换设备或清缓存会丢失: Views are stored on this device only — they are lost if you switch machines or clear the cache
角色只定义身份；具体能看哪些菜单、点哪些按钮，在右侧「功能权限」里配。: A role only defines an identity; which menus and buttons it can reach is configured under Permissions on the right.
触发过一次就不再触发；记录会保留，不会自动删除。: Fires once and never again; the record is kept, not deleted.
记录后台每一次接口调用的请求、响应与耗时。点操作时间看完整详情。: Every admin API call with its request, response and duration. Click the time for full detail.
该会话有活跃的 WebSocket 连接: This session has a live WebSocket connection
该接口仅超级管理员可用。: This endpoint is available to superusers only.

该组总开关已关闭，配置不生效: This group is switched off, its settings do not apply
该角色关闭了「启用数据权限过滤」，可以看到全量数据 —— 这里绑的范围暂时不会生: This role has data-scope filtering switched off and sees all data, so the scopes bound here have no effect for now.

超管绕过所有权限码与数据范围校验，等于把整个平台交给这个账号。: A superuser bypasses every permission code and data-scope check — it hands the whole platform to that account.

路由挂到 {{app}} 应用下，实际前缀会带上该应用的段: Routes mount under the {{app}} application, so the real prefix includes that application’s segment
还没有数据范围。先去「系统管理 › 数据权限」建一个，再回来绑定。: No data scopes yet. Create one under System › Data permissions, then come back to bind it.

这些字段只能由管理员在「用户管理」里改: Only an admin can change these fields, under Users
